🚨 We're Hiring at Acetech Group Corporation! 🚨
Are you passionate about US IT Recruitment or Bench Sales? Join our growing team and take your career to the next level!
Open Positions:
🔹 US IT Recruiters
🔹 Bench Sales Recruiters
📍 Location: Gachibowli, Hyderabad
🏢 Work Mode: Work from Office
What We're Looking For:
✅ Experience in US IT Recruitment or Bench Sales
✅ Excellent communication and negotiation skills
✅ Strong understanding of the US staffing industry
✅ Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
🎯 Interview Process: Single Round – In-Person Interview
If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to work with a dynamic team, we'd love to hear from you!
📩 Share your resume at [mohammad@acetech.group] or send me a direct message for more details.
